Inside the loop, write n += x; (this means add x to n).

steps.explanation: Keep the supplied function and result list. Rebuild the part that fills the list using the example as a guide. Re-run whenever you want to check a change.
steps.task: Fill the result list using this topic's rule.
hints: This graph has two-way links between points. Points belong to the same group if you can travel between them, even through other points. Use union-find: start with one group per point, then join groups when a link connects them. For each point, count all points in its group, including itself. Record these counts in point order. A link from a point to itself does not make a larger group. A graph with no points gives an empty result list.
Revisit the example and copy one instruction at a time, checking what it does.
